Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add configurable template system for visual import model creation

Implemented a comprehensive visual template creation system that allows users to:
- Visually annotate example text to create reusable import templates
- Apply templates to new text for automated actor creation
- Support multiple parsing modes (toNewline, toSpace, toChar, multiline, regex, construct, list)
- Save, export, and import templates as JSON files
- Manage templates per game system with full CRUD operations

New Features:
- ImportTemplateManager: Template storage and management with Foundry settings
- TemplateParser: Token-based parser engine with transformation support
- ImportTemplateApp: Dual-panel visual annotation UI (create/apply modes)
- ConstructEditorModal: Pattern editor for regex-based field extraction
- SaveTemplateModal: Template metadata editor with export functionality
- Template library with per-system organization

UI Components:
- Split-panel interface (source text + annotated model)
- System-specific field buttons (Daggerheart, D&D 5e, Project FU, etc.)
- Annotation tools (Skip, Multiline, Construct, List, Transform)
- Real-time visual feedback with highlighting
- Template test/preview functionality

Technical Implementation:
- ES6 modules (.mjs) following existing module architecture
- Handlebars templates for consistent UI rendering
- Comprehensive CSS styling for professional appearance
- Bilingual support (EN/FR) with i18n strings
- Integration with existing actor-importer system
- Accessible via game.ActorImporter.showTemplateCreator()

Documentation:
- Complete TEMPLATE_SYSTEM.md guide with workflows and examples
- API documentation for programmatic template creation
- Examples for common use cases (Daggerheart stat blocks)

This system transforms the actor import process from hardcoded parsers to
user-configurable visual templates, enabling support for any text-based
format without code changes.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
